verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a developer framework/SDK for building agents, not an end-user product with its own data store or UI where a user views 'their data' and receives AI-generated insights; that surface would be built by developers using the framework, not delivered by Pydantic AI itself. This is a category mismatch — the axis of 'insights from my data inside the product' applies to end-user data products, not to an agent-building library.
